question: Is the OpenAI live-stream proof plus the shared provider regression matrix sufficient to land the unified processor without separate Azure and ChatGPT/Codex live-provider runs?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes common runtime behavior for three provider surfaces, while available real-provider proof directly covers OpenAI and the other two surfaces are covered through shared tests and caller-specific suites.

options.title: Require refreshed cross-provider proof
options.body: Rebase onto current main and add redacted Azure and ChatGPT/Codex live evidence where those provider profiles and lanes are available before merge.

options.title: Accept the scoped proof set
options.body: Explicitly accept the OpenAI live run and shared Azure/ChatGPT caller matrix as sufficient because the canonical processor is common and the unavailable live lanes are documented.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped proof set
recommendation.body: Explicitly accept the OpenAI live run and shared Azure/ChatGPT caller matrix as sufficient because the canonical processor is common and the unavailable live lanes are documented.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the active implementation and its merged fixture prerequisite, so they are the most informed routing candidate for the remaining proof scope.
